name: Casas de Don Antonio (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue vertical stripe through the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Casas de Don Antonio (a cross of Saint James, a castle and a bridge).
history: Municipal flag of Casas de Don Antonio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Casas de Don Antonio arms — cross of Saint James, castle and bridge
